stats.win: 63.16% of the 78 new Night V7 legs closed in profit (48W/28L)
stats.source: MT4 test SP500_DAYTRADE v1.12 (his run 4 Nov, Magic 500119, spread 18, Every tick), 2018.01.01-2026.10.31, 2,581 trades (+78 vs the 500117 baseline's 2,503, all long - V7 is BUY only); max DD $2,155.51 (0.21%, DOWN from 500117's $2,188.15 - the first leg where DD actually falls, not just holds steady); same 500117 rules (row18/19/20/23/24/25-27/28-31/32-34) PLUS Night V7 (rows 35-37): a 6th night trigger, no weekday restriction, on the materials sector (XLB) being relatively weak vs SPY (252-day percentile of the XLB/SPY ratio LEVEL <= 0.30) combined with the communications-services sector (XLC) rallying sharply vs SPY (252-day percentile of the 10-day % change in the XLC/SPY ratio >= 0.85) - isolating the 78 new legs alone: net +$757.18, DD improved $32.64 vs 500117, 63.16% closed in profit (a touch below the Python hardening estimate of 68.8%, flagged honestly). WATCH ITEM: 93 historical Python occurrences (biggest sample of any night trigger this project; 78 confirmed in MT4 after excluding nights V2-V6 already took, after an initial 0-trade run traced to a stale/uncompiled .ex4 and fixed by a recompile), moderate date clustering (a 15-night May 2020 episode and a 12-night Sep 2025 episode) - treat as a refinement still proving itself, not a settled edge. Like Night V5/V6, this data (Yahoo Finance XLB/XLC/SPY) is available from day one - no live warm-up needed (see mt_cm_today() in sp_run.py).

US500.day_note: 14-day range 104 pts · stop 0.75 x range (= 78 pts) · no half-close · the day's first signal sets BUY or SELL, later signals the same way add (max 3 trades) · v1.04: no 2nd/3rd trade from 11:00 am New York or once the day is up half a stop · signals: Nasdaq desk signals copied in US hours + S&P 9:40 am New York move, yesterday high/low sweep, big move by 10 am New York · close 3:30 pm New York · NIGHT trade on high-fear nights (VIX above VIX3M, or VIX / VVIX in their 1-year top 10%): BUY 6:01 pm New York (v1.07: Mon/Tue/Wed broker-days only), stop 1 x range (v1.07, was 2x), close 10:00 am New York · v1.07 TURN-OF-MONTH: on the last broker weekday of the month and the first 3 of the next, BUY 9:30 am New York, stop 0.75 x range, close 3:30 pm New York - only on a day with no other S&P trade · v1.08 NIGHT V3: a 2nd, independent night trigger (only fires when the night trade above does not - never both), broker-day Wed/Thu/Fri only, on a gold+WTI combined overnight shock (the smaller of gold's and WTI's own 252-day-percentile |daily move|, from 2 days before, >= 0.70): BUY 6:01 pm New York, stop 1 x range, close 10:00 am New York - same mechanics as the night leg above · v1.09 NIGHT V4: a 3rd, independent night trigger (only fires when the two night trades above do not - never more than one a night), no weekday restriction, on a weak last-hour close (252-day percentile of the 15:00-16:00 New York return <= 0.30) combined with a last-hour volume spike (z-score vs its own trailing 20-day average >= 2.0): BUY 6:01 pm New York, stop 1 x range, close 10:00 am New York - same mechanics as the other night trades. WATCH ITEM (only 25 historical occurrences, mostly overlapping the VIX night trade above) - needs ~2-4 weeks of its own live volume history before it can fire at all · v1.10 NIGHT V5: a 4th, independent night trigger (only fires when the three night trades above do not - never more than one a night), no weekday restriction, on the US Dollar Index weakening over 5 days (252-day percentile of the 5-day % change <= 0.20) combined with the market narrowing on both a 10-day AND a 20-day horizon (252-day percentile of the RSP/SPY equal-weight/cap-weight ratio's 10-day and 20-day % change, both <= 0.20): BUY 6:01 pm New York, stop 1 x range, close 10:00 am New York - same mechanics as the other night trades. WATCH ITEM (20 historical Python occurrences, 18 confirmed in MT4) - unlike Night V4, this data is available from day one, no live warm-up needed · v1.11 NIGHT V6: a 5th, independent night trigger (only fires when the four night trades above do not - never more than one a night), no weekday restriction, on the broad trade-weighted US Dollar index (FRED DTWEXBGS, 26-currency basket) being broadly weak (252-day percentile of its level <= 0.15) combined with the pan-European STOXX50E index having a shock move the prior session (252-day percentile of its |daily % close move| >= 0.85): BUY 6:01 pm New York, stop 1 x range, close 10:00 am New York - same mechanics as the other night trades. WATCH ITEM (24 historical Python occurrences, 14 confirmed in MT4) - like Night V5, this data is available from day one, no live warm-up needed · v1.12 NIGHT V7: a 6th, independent night trigger (only fires when the five night trades above do not - never more than one a night), no weekday restriction, on the materials sector (XLB) being relatively weak vs SPY (252-day percentile of the XLB/SPY ratio level <= 0.30) combined with the communications-services sector (XLC) rallying sharply vs SPY (252-day percentile of the 10-day % change in the XLC/SPY ratio >= 0.85): BUY 6:01 pm New York, stop 1 x range, close 10:00 am New York - same mechanics as the other night trades. WATCH ITEM (93 historical Python occurrences, the biggest sample of any night trigger this project; 78 confirmed in MT4) - like Night V5/V6, this data is available from day one, no live warm-up needed
